title: A Defence of Poesie and Poems
sourceTitle: A Defence of Poesie and Poems
author: Philip Sidney
description: "A Defence of Poesie and Poems" by Philip Sidney is a work of literary criticism written around 1580 and published in 1595.
longDescription: Sidney argues that poetry surpasses both history and philosophy in inspiring readers toward virtue by combining historical liveliness with ethical purpose.

authorInfo.bio: Sir Philip Sidney was an English poet, courtier, scholar and soldier who is remembered as one of the most prominent figures of the Elizabethan age.
